label: BL
reason: Alert 1 (xss): User input from request.getParameter reaches response.getWriter().println() wrapped in HTML comment syntax. The replace('-->', '') removes the closing delimiter to prevent comment truncation, but user content is still reflected. While browsers typically don't execute scripts inside comments, this pattern involves user-controlled data reaching an HTML output sink. The exact exploitability depends on browser version, parser behavior, and deployment context not visible in the snippet. Resolved sink value: "<!-- " + param (minus '-->') + " -->" where param is attacker-controllable.

evidence.note: User param flows through replace() into HTML comment output at response.getWriter()
